name: Replay Disc
summary: A one-tap reorder where past orders are records and playing one puts every item back in the cart
about: A reorder panel drawn as a turntable with three past orders as record sleeves. Choosing a sleeve slides its record out and drops it on the platter with the order's items as the track list. Order again lowers the tone arm and spins the record up; each track lights up with a little equalizer, rechecks today's price or swaps an out-of-stock item, and sends a music note into the cart, before the record spins down in a burst of notes.
how: Tap a sleeve or use the arrow keys: the record slides out and drops onto the platter
The track list shows what you ordered last time and what it cost
Press Order again: the arm swings on, the record spins up and each item plays into the cart
Price changes since last time show as old and new prices with an up or down mark
An out-of-stock item is swapped for a close match and the note tells you which one
